notes: Check BigCommerce → inbox shipment → UPS; reply with tracking + ETA.
Capelli error — request an evidence picture of the wrong item before acting.
Shopify order = FBPA. Request an evidence picture of the wrong/blank item.
When WE shipped the wrong size (vs customer ordering wrong), it is our fault. Request a picture of the wrong item, then replace with the correct (ordered) item.
Wrong product shipped — request a picture, then replacement of the correct item.

Wrong-club decoration is a production error affecting a whole team. Request a clear photo of ALL affected items in one shot, escalate to DM/operations — do not just reship, since the wrong artwork can repeat.
No expedite option. Standard processing is 5 weeks; explain and confirm awaiting fulfillment.
We do not offer expedited shipping; orders are worked in the order received. Quote the correct processing timeline and confirm awaiting fulfillment.
Cannot change number without coach confirmation. Verify not in production, put order on hold (email Ops), ask customer to CC coach.
If already processing/prepared for shipment: cannot change once it has entered the processing stage. If not yet in production: put on hold and confirm the corrected size before releasing.
Check production status first. Contact the appropriate department; if in processing, advise the change cannot be made.
Confirm not in FBB list and not delivered in SAP. Cancel on BC, email ROLO for refund (CC manager + ticket #).
If not yet fulfilled/delivered, cancel on BigCommerce and process refund (24h to process, 3–5 business days to appear). If already processing/shipping, it cannot be cancelled.
Confirm details (e.g., coupon/credit), confirm not fulfilled, then cancel + refund.
Customer selected "No" for adding the player number at checkout = customer error. No action; they can reorder + return.
Confirm the exact missing item against the order, then advise fulfillment to ship the missing item to the order address.
Confirm the missing line item and ship it. If the customer later tires of waiting and asks for a refund instead, route to refund_request.
No exchanges — send the return policy; customer returns for a refund.

No exchanges. Send the return policy: 30 days, unworn/unwashed with tags, personalized items non-returnable, mandatory-kit items not returnable on their own (but refunded once a new correct-size order is placed). Returns to Capelli Sport Returns, Pittston PA.
No exchanges — return for refund and place a new order in the desired size.
We cannot add to an existing order — send the template explaining they must place a new order.
Cannot add to an existing order. Place a new order; as a one-time courtesy advise the new order number so shipping can be refunded.
Provide the size chart; the team store is found via the club password/app.
Create a replacement order on BC, same address; note replacement # next to original in tags; Open + internal note until shipped.

Per policy, replacements are made ONLY in the same size (and same form) as originally ordered. Politely hold the line; a size change requires a return + new order. Goodwill size swaps are a manager exception, not the default.
Mandatory-kit items must stay in the cart — removing a required item breaks checkout. If they later ordered, confirm processing time.
Known club-wide issue — escalate to Dan; reply that the right department is engaged; Open + internal note.

Phone support is not offered; only email. For strong complaints/Trustpilot reviews, escalate to a manager — goodwill (replacement/coupon/refund) may be approved as an exception. Acknowledge the specific failure rather than repeating a generic apology.
Decoration/defective — request an evidence picture of the defective item.
Standard opener: products undergo strict quality checks and we regret it slipped past. Request a clear picture, then advise fulfillment to send a replacement in the SAME size originally ordered.
Defective non-decoration item also qualifies. Request a picture, then replacement in the same size/form.
Bag/equipment defect. Request pictures; replacement may need internal (DM) approval before the RO is created.
A repeat-defect replacement is a red flag — do NOT re-issue the same RO blindly. Escalate to a manager and confirm the corrected artwork before reshipping.
Order held up because an additional piece was added. Find the tracking + ETA in the inbox and reply with the FBB tracking template.
Player links are managed by the club — we cannot create them from outside. Direct the customer to their club administrator.
Player numbers/roster are entered by the club admin, not Capelli. Direct the customer (and ideally CC the club) to have the club update the roster; we cannot change it on our side.
Ask for player name + club to point them to the right mandatory package, but roster details are club-managed.
Team-store access is club-managed; never share club passwords with customers — direct them to their club administrator.

A shipping label is generated before the package physically ships; UPS will not show movement until it is scanned. Reassure that UPS is expected to receive it by end of week, and to reach back if no update in 2–3 business days. Do NOT promise a hard delivery date.
Same label-created reassurance, but acknowledge the deadline empathetically. We do not offer expedited shipping — do not promise it will arrive by the event.
Order has departed the warehouse to UPS for final delivery; tracking will not update until UPS scans it. Provide the UPS link and the "not updated in 2–3 days, contact us" fallback.
Refunds take ~24h to process and 3–5 business days to appear, under "Capelli Sport". If overdue, check with the refunds team before promising a date.
Shipping-cost refund for excessive delay is a goodwill gesture requiring internal approval. Once approved, advise 24h to process. Own the follow-up — do not loop holding replies.

Severely overdue / never delivered. Do NOT default to reship when the need has passed (season over). Acknowledge the missed prior requests, escalate for a refund/credit decision, and take ownership of the reply rather than re-sending generic holds.
Confirm the carrier claim, escalate to the appropriate department for reship or refund per policy.
Email Planning (RN/RI) to replenish the specific SKU/size; advise the customer once restocked. Do not promise a firm restock date.
Distinguish timelines: stock items 3–7 business days, pre-order 3–6 weeks, mandatory/team kits 5 weeks. Acknowledge the confusion; do not offer expedite.
Only items currently on the website are available; some sizes are out of stock due to demand. Cannot add to an existing order — a new order is required.
24h after the full mandatory kit is purchased, log in, choose the kit/player, then "Enable Adding Individual Products" to order single items. Cannot add to an existing order.
